I want to open a general discussion about what things should have happened in Star Wars but never did. I obviously think pretty much everything in the prequels and everything in the sequels should not have happened. But I would go a step further and say that Leia should never have been Luke's sister. I think, based on A New Hope, that Leia probably should have been Luke's love interest and a second love interest should have shown up for Han.

I also think that, based on the original Empire Strikes Back that the Emperor was being rolled out as a possible deformed clone of Obi Wan. The original version has a character that looks deformed and sounds almost exactly like Alec Guinness. I think this would have been a more interesting use of cloning technology than simply cloning troops.

I also imagined Anakin as looking more like Joaquin Phoenix, Keanu Reeves or even Ed Skrein. A darker featured, charismatic, older and more masculine heroic character. And taking us all the way to his childhood was also a pointless decision. We should have been introduced to him during the middle of the clone wars. We should have been dropped off right in the middle of the clone wars and there should not have been any R2 or C3PO or Jar Jar but still some fun characters who look like this guy or a greedo-like character or a different R2 style-unit like this. And I think the clone wars should have been about Sith cloning Jedi's and turning them to the dark side. And we should have seen Anakin doing extraordinary things as a Jedi, there should have been a ridiculous number of interesting space battles, like 50% of the prequels should have been space battles, far less political bullshit and Anakin's turn to the dark side should have been after Padme is killed, not before and the Jedi should have been almost entirely murdered. It would have been easy to do this because the clones could have infiltrated the Jedi. There also shouldn't have been any clone troops at all. I don't think they even hinted at this in the OT.

An interesting idea for a sequel trilogy could have involved something completely alien to the whole Star Wars universe, like time travel, maybe having to do with Boba Fett or the Mandalorians. Luke's children could have been pulled into an even more futuristic era of the Star Wars Galaxy by some distant relative to fight against a Dark Force user or Mandalorian who is messing with the whole space time continuum. It could have involved them going to different eras in the whole Star Wars time line, even meeting up with Yoda when he is just getting started with his training and going deep into the future. Sounds a little crazy but it would have been way more interesting than rehashing the OT and it could have introduced even more weird ships and crazy shit we've never seen. Eureka 7 ao did the whole time travel thing, as did back to the future. I liked both films and think time travel, although alien to Star Wars would be an interesting addition to an already amazing plot rather than different types of lightsabers and the same story rolled out with every film.

Anyhow, if you think these ideas are dumb or not, you probably think they are dumb because it's a subjective thing really, they are how I would have written Star Wars if I were in charge. Tell me what you think and what ideas you would have had. Maybe Star Wars was different for everyone. Some love the new films. I'm not one of them, I imagined everything happening very very differently. Anyway...Leave your thoughts.
